ossMetrics.title: The pulse of open source.
ossMetrics.description: A transparent view of contributor flow, maintainer throughput, and portfolio breadth across every repository listed on Crafter Station OSS.
ossMetrics.signalTitle: The factory is closing more work per day.
ossMetrics.signalDescription: Post-launch activity is compared with an equally long pre-launch window. No accumulated history, no vanity denominator.
ossMetrics.metricsTitle: Four signals for reading portfolio health.

metrics.throughputDescription: Issues and pull requests closed per day across the complete OSS portfolio.
metrics.mergesDescription: Pull requests merged per day, separated from PRs closed without merge.
metrics.externalClosedDescription: Human contributions from outside the maintainer group resolved per day.
metrics.activeReposDescription: Repositories with at least one issue or pull request closed in the window.

radar.title: The queue has memory now.
radar.description: xref reconciles each repository backlog, keeps changes between sweeps, and separates review, cleanup, and discovery without mutating GitHub.
radar.coverageDescription: Maintained repositories read without failures or coverage limits.
radar.reconcileDescription: Candidates requiring human verification before work is closed, replaced, or relinked.
radar.reviewDescription: Open pull requests ready to enter the factory review gate.
radar.discoverDescription: Repositories with no active queue move to dogfooding and product direction.

ossMetrics.flowTitle: Opened versus resolved, normalized by time.
ossMetrics.flowDescription: Each bar is a daily rate over matched windows. The comparison stays fair as the launch window grows, capped at fourteen days.
ossMetrics.acquisitionTitle: More output does not automatically mean more contributors.
ossMetrics.acquisitionDescription: External inbound and maintainer clearing are shown separately so a maintenance sprint cannot masquerade as community growth.
ossMetrics.externalOpenedDescription: The cleanest early signal that the catalog is attracting contribution attempts.
ossMetrics.externalResolvedDescription: How quickly the organization turns outside contributions into decisions.
ossMetrics.backlogDescription: Opened minus closed work per day. Negative means the queue shrank during the window.
ossMetrics.distributionTitle: Portfolio health needs breadth, not one heroic repo.
ossMetrics.distributionDescription: Aggregate throughput can hide concentration. This view shows exactly where the closed work happened.
ossMetrics.concentrationDescription: of all post-launch closures came from the two busiest repositories.
ossMetrics.methodologyDescription: The dashboard is deliberately opinionated about what counts, who counts as external, and how launch comparisons stay fair.

methodologyItems.1: All repositories currently listed on /oss are included across the Crafter Station network, including Crafter Research.
methodologyItems.2: Before and after use the same elapsed time, capped at fourteen days and expressed as rates per day.
methodologyItems.3: External means a human author who is not an owner, organization member, or repository collaborator.
methodologyItems.4: GitHub Search is refreshed hourly. If it is unavailable, the page labels and serves the last verified snapshot.
methodologyItems.5: Repositories added after launch are included as current portfolio operations. Their earlier activity is context, not causal launch impact.

ossMetrics.contributeTitle: The numbers move when someone ships.
ossMetrics.contributeDescription: Pick a maintained repository, find a focused issue, and send the next pull request into the system.
